entry.title: Templo Mayor

groundCutout.basis: Bounded mapped below-grade excavation; its entire opening has an opaque authored floor at every LOD. Surrounding terrain remains native.

buildingCutout.basis: Only the mapped main-pyramid excavation and the three authored covers inside it; independent surrounding buildings remain native.

terrainReference.basis: The original 161-square/6m standard Mapzen grid is retained unchanged. A bounded opening follows only the mapped layer−1 main-pyramid footprint. An opaque authored floor seals the entire pocket at every LOD, conservatively below the sampled coarse grade; retaining sides rise to the native boundary. This is a visualization datum, not an excavation survey. Surrounding terrain, native water, independent buildings and the mapped pedestrian alignment remain intact. The authored supported crossing follows that pedestrian alignment above the pocket.

entry.note: Q774021/way1423783282 identifies the main-pyramid footprint. Four pinned standard PMTiles records control that below-street outline and three protective covers. Named map points fix the older Tláloc shrine to the north and Huitzilopochtli shrine to the south. The ordinary west-side picture establishes west-facing stair runs; the mapped outline/canopy edges give an approximately 5.85-degree east/south construction axis.
